scope: Audit navigation only. Does not add or modify any claim's historical proof_location or assert a claim-specific proof pointer where the old ledger has none.
interpretation: Explicit paths are resolved at the artifact root or relative to the directory containing the claim's component_ledger.
The preserved root-level baseline component ledger moved to history/version_0_15; its original component_ledger field is retained and resolved only by the explicit audit alias.
The literal combined walk path is split by the explicit alias above.
For old claims with no proof_location, the listed files are preserved component corpus evidence only.
A textual occurrence of the claim ID is recorded separately; it is not treated as an exact theorem-to-proof correspondence.
If no claim ID occurs in the archival corpus, the audit reports archival corpus fallback only.
Historical page numbers in the preserved filename map are never interpreted as current v0.22 page numbers.
